VBO:0201096.summary: Friendly and keen on attention in her owner’s account, four-year-old Daphne is a Pugalier, a Pug–Cavalier King Charles Spaniel cross. Another named Pugalier, Simba, enjoys sofa cuddles and chasing a ball; with handler Amy, Simba joins a Story Dogs reading team at a Beaumaris primary school.
